interpretation: All tests are the required scoped suites, not a claim that every repository test ran.

Hosted IPv6 loopback uses TEST_ONLY mechanics. The contained label is a fixture phase, not AppContainer isolation. Profile-only and invalid-CLI negatives do not exercise a valid production network CLI.
The Linux paused no-guest QEMU mechanism observes mapped backing-file identity and local package metadata/integrity, not resident bytes, upstream source equivalence or guest networking.

ICMP diagnostics are bounded observations only. Exact raw selected-frame bytes, structured quoted packets, checksum consistency, tuple direction and the direct UDP payload observation remain separate. Even a checksum-consistent forged quote does not prove authenticity, actor attribution or original packet delivery.
The existing reached-NH58 filter is unchanged: owned guest source MAC and fixed outer fixture destination. Unsupported ICMP still sets opaque_protocol and blocks the existing absence conclusion.

Runtime04 remains failed/inconclusive: two guest-to-fixture NH58 candidates were observed, but their type, code and quoted contents were not retained. This short gate cannot reconstruct deleted capture or reinterpret that result.
No Windows guest VM or new runtime was launched. No no-IPv6-egress, DNS, proxy, descendant IPv6 or product-acceptance claim follows.

observations.icmp_parser_tests: synthetic byte fixtures only; no new guest ICMP capture
